title: Moderation configuration
description: Configure the various channels, i.e. what should happen to comment after they've been processed.

options.title: Moderation options
options.description: Shared options across all moderation channels

enabled.title: Toggle on/off
enabled.description: If false, the moderation channel is off. Default is true.

allow*.title: Allow list for this moderation channel
allow*.description: If a comment author matches this list, e.g. their pseudonym, then that information will be passed to whatever is handling the moderation. Usually this will result in comment bypassing moderation, although it depends on how the moderation channel is implemented. The name that is matched against will depend on the upstream commenting channel. For example, comments via email will be a pseudo-anonymized string of the commenter's email address. The "allow*" name means glob syntax is allowed. Default is `[]`.

comments.title: Comment sources
comments.description: Specify which commenting sources to allow for this moderation channel. Default is undefined, which skips this check altogether.

filter*.title: Filter site
filter*.description: Specifies which sites, by label, will have comments moderated. The 'filter*' name means a glob pattern can be provided. See `site` config key for more details. Default is undefined, which skips this check altogether.
